summary: Sealed rowing-club car park by the river, trees on the east edge, no homes.
reasons: Open sealed car park, room for a van

drivers.seclusion: Riverside bush to the north and east, boat shed to the west; only the water sports centre 5 m from the west end, no dwellings seen.
drivers.access_and_room: Open entrance off the park road; marked bays with plenty of room.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end spur off the park road.
drivers.convention: A few cars and stored rowing boats; clubs use it by day, no campers seen.

flags: Low ground: about 6 m elevation and a waterway 28 m away, flood-prone
Rowing club may be busy early mornings and weekends
Locked mapped gate 47 m away has another way round
sun_shade: Tree shade from the east and north in the morning, open to the west.

best_section.where: East edge of the rowing club car park, beside the river trees
